'''Amethio's mansion''' (Japanese: '''アメジオの屋敷''' ''Amethio's mansion'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive building. It appeared in ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]''.

==History==
<!--===Pre-series===
===={{aniseries|HZ}}====-->
In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', [[Amethio]] invited [[Onia]] and [[Zirc]] to his luxurious mansion. They learn about the history of his family and what occurred 100 years prior. 

In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', Onia and Zirc invited [[Liko]] to his mansion. They were able to find a clue to Amethio's whereabouts through a picture of him when he was younger.
{{-}}
